features.title: Skills and precision
features.text: Frequent skill increases and skill feats let you cover many jobs outside combat. Your racket shapes your tactics and can offer Strength, Intelligence or Charisma as your key attribute instead of Dexterity.

features.title: Sneak Attack
features.text: Deal extra precision damage against off-guard foes. Find ways to create that opening through allies, positioning or skills, then choose attacks and tricks that exploit it.
